justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/common/ECIEncoderSet.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/common/MinimalECIInput.java, and core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/encoder/MinimalEncoder.java. ECIEncoderSet is a compact final helper (199 lines) with only two fields and one constructor plus 7 small public methods, all centered on one cohesive responsibility: selecting allowed CharsetEncoders for an input string and exposing charset/ECI lookup and encode/canEncode operations. The callers use it only for that purpose, and I did not find distinct responsibility clusters or low-cohesion behavior that would indicate insufficient modularization.
